Physical model-header/cell rectangles and native word coordinates distinguish shared cells from unknown entries. RS reach and repeatability groups, heavy-load masses/controllers, RD five-axis versus CP four-axis entries and the ZX200S literal ±0.3 mm repeatability remain model-specific. No silent decimal correction or unqualified highest-IP inheritance is made.

YF002N and YF003N are overhead four-axis delta robots with 2/3 kg loads and 600×200/1300×500 mm cylindrical work envelopes. Their two tables repeat 60 kg, IP65 and E91; cycle times retain load and 25/305/25 mm round-trip test scope. Envelope diameter is not scalar arm reach or body dimensions. Palletizing cycles/hour retain their 400/2000/400 mm test pattern.

CL103N/105N/108N/110N and duAro1/2 are distinct named collaborative offerings. duAro has two four-axis arms, 2 kg or 3 kg per arm; paired 4/6 kg headings are not per-arm ratings. The 207/220 kg assembly scope and trolley inclusion are not separately itemized; missing reach/IP values stay unknown. Collaborative positioning does not establish a universal safe speed or application fencing exemption.

KJ wrist loads 8/15 kg stay separate from arm loads 10/25 kg; KJ264 has seven axes. Ex/ATEX text is not an IP ingress rating. MC004N has a dash in the VHP row, whereas MC004V/MC006V list sterilizability; MS005N separately lists stainless steel, seven axes and IP69K. Food-grade, Fraunhofer, cleanroom and sterilizability wording remains attributed without independent certificate or medical-device approval proof.

Controllers, teach pendants, grippers, K-ROSET/AS programming, safety options, servo positioners and linear tracks are components/software/integration equipment rather than additional complete robot identities. February 2026 printed revision and May 2026 PDF metadata are not launch years. Current prices/stock, complete historical portfolios, exclusive USPs, independent performance and market/search leadership remain unproven.
